## Research Analyst
 
 
Research 
San Francisco, CA 
Full-time   
 
 
### About the Role
 

We are looking for a Research Analyst to join our growing team. You will work on identifying and evaluating the most impactful giving opportunities worldwide.
 
### Responsibilities
 
 
- Conduct in-depth research on global health interventions 
- Analyze cost-effectiveness data and build quantitative models 
- Write clear reports summarizing findings and recommendations 
- Collaborate with program officers to identify new grant opportunities 
 
### Requirements
 
 
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field 
- 2+ years of research experience 
- Strong analytical and writing skills 
- Interest in effective altruism and evidence-based giving 
 
### Compensation
 

Salary range: $80,000 - $120,000 depending on experience. We offer comprehensive benefits including health insurance, 401(k) matching, and generous PTO.
